topic.source_contract: Sustainable-drainage standards, runoff hierarchy, surface-water risk, LLFA consultation, maintenance and discharge evidence

facts.status: current national standards are non-statutory guidance
facts.guard: standards compliance is not planning approval or adoption

facts.design: runoff hierarchy, extreme rainfall, water quality, amenity, biodiversity and maintenance
facts.guard: generic design principles are not site feasibility

facts.consultation: major development with surface-water drainage requires LLFA consultation

facts.planning: FRA, climate change and drainage policy tests
facts.guard: planning policy does not grant discharge consent

facts.consents: planning and environmental permissions may both be needed

scope_guards: A SuDS strategy is not treated as planning approval.
National-standard alignment is not treated as site-specific feasibility.
Infiltration is not treated as feasible without ground, groundwater and contamination tests.
LLFA consultation is not treated as technical approval or adoption.
Sewer-company correspondence is not treated as a connection agreement.
A discharge rate is not treated as secured without an agreed outfall and rights.
Maintenance proposals are not treated as funded and legally secured arrangements.
No score or promotion is written without exact catchment, tests, calculations, outfall, approvals, adoption and maintenance evidence.
